page.overview:
Who is Mog?

Mog is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. Mog is a recurring name for a moogle in the Final Fantasy series.

In the Miniventure "A Duo of Three," Cactuar Conductor and Mog come to the aid of Master Tonberry in the Coliseum. Both Cactuar and Mog decide to address Tonberry with new nicknames, much to his annoyance.

Mog can be fought and imprismed at the Coliseum and goes by the name "Master Moogle".
